scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run dev -w @storyhaven/api" "npm run dev -w @storyhaven/web" "npm run worker -w @storyhaven/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @storyhaven/api && npm run build -w @storyhaven/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests infra docs *.md *.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts tests infra docs *.md *.json
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run start -w @storyhaven/api" "npm run start -w @storyhaven/web" "npm run worker:start -w @storyhaven/api"
